verdict.rationale: Adyen Risk Management is an ML-driven SaaS fraud service, so whether customer data can be excluded from model training is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no opt-out or training-exclusion control. The docs instead state that the risk engine uses machine learning and Adyen's global transaction data, which points the other way.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
